author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: backlog export (CSV, 90 to 140 tickets with priority, estimate, depends_on, skill tag), team roster with per-person focus factor and sprint dates, holidays and an on-call rotation, and a short note from the director
scenario: The director says: plan the next three sprints for the team so that the must-haves for the beta land, and tell me what does not fit. On-call weeks cost a person half their capacity.
seeds: (1) capacity per sprint must account for holidays, on-call halving and focus factor; (2) one must-have depends on a should-have, so the should-have must be pulled in; (3) one person is the only one with a needed skill tag and is over-allocated if the plan is naive; (4) the must-haves alone exceed sprint 1 capacity, so order matters; (5) an unestimated must-have ticket that should be called out, not silently dropped.
shape: {"capacity_by_sprint": {"<sprint>": points}, "sprints": {"<sprint>": [ticket ids]}, "not_fitting": [ids], "pulled_in_dependencies": [ids], "over_allocated": [{"person": str, "sprint": str, "assigned": n, "capacity": n}], "unestimated": [ids]}
expertSources: The Scrum Guide 2020, https://scrumguides.org/scrum-guide.html (CC BY-SA 4.0, idea only)
GitLab Handbook, Product processes, https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/product-processes/ (CC BY-SA 4.0, idea only)
